subject.title: Feature proposal: codexbar guard — a quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should CodexBar own a first-class quota-gating command with a stable exit-code contract for scripts and agent loops?
rationale: This adds a new public automation policy rather than fixing existing behavior, and VISION.md requires sign-off for new features.

options.title: Adopt narrow guard MVP
options.body: Approve single-provider percentage gating while requiring stable unknown-data, exit-code, and JSON semantics in the linked PR.

options.title: Keep CLI observational
options.body: Decline active gating and leave automation callers to interpret existing usage JSON themselves.

options.title: Expose derived data first
options.body: Add structured remaining-headroom data to existing JSON before deciding whether CodexBar should enforce gating policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt narrow guard MVP
recommendation.body: Approve single-provider percentage gating while requiring stable unknown-data, exit-code, and JSON semantics in the linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The available repository history and VISION.md make steipete the clearest owner of new CLI product-surface decisions.
